description: This file defines a SkipTagsAggregator class that extends SimpleTextAggregator to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tag pairs, ensuring tagged content is processed as a unit.

classes.name: SkipTagsAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator that buffers text and prevents sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tags, useful for processing tagged content as a single unit.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator with a sequence of StartEndTags defining the tag pairs to prevent sentence splitting.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, updating tag state and yielding sentence boundary aggregations when appropriate.

methods.name: handle_interruption
methods.description: Resets the internal state and tag tracking upon interruption in processing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears buffered text and resets tag state to initial conditions.
